build_prompt_encoder: build a PromptEncoder module to encode point, box, and mask prompts for SAM mask decoder input
embed_points: embed point prompts with coordinates and labels into sparse embeddings using the PromptEncoder
embed_boxes: embed box prompts with corner coordinates into sparse embeddings using the PromptEncoder
embed_masks: embed mask inputs through the mask downscaling conv layers into dense embeddings
get_dense_pe: get the dense positional encoding tensor for the image embedding size from the PromptEncoder
